prep.why: SaveGameList.sav decides which slots exist and which save a character card loads (the newest SaveTime of that character). Every run autosaves into slots 10-14 with the current date, so a fixed autosave slot cannot stay the one the card loads, and a file copied into a slot the list marks unused is ignored (demo2's orphan HL-01/02/03 files never show). So the ladder uses manual slot 10 (HL-0c-09, unused by every character on demo1) registered once in the list with a 2099 date: the card then always loads it, and the harness only replaces that one HL file per rung.
once: Game closed. Back up the live folder (copy %LOCALAPPDATA%\Hogwarts Legacy\Saved\SaveGames\1790552345 to runs\save-backups\<stamp>-hogwarts-before-ladder).

Check the live SaveGameList.sav is still the snapshot one (sha256 1EE63A378E161238BD801842CC389204401260AF181E1470CADE7338F01CAC76). If not (another Hogwarts run autosaved since), rebuild the prep list from the live one: hl_save.py register <live list> a.sav --slot HL-00-09 --from <own>\demo1-1790552345-20261002\HL-00-13.sav, then the same for HL-01-09 (HL-01-13), HL-02-09 (HL-02-10), HL-03-09 (HL-03-12), chaining the outputs.

Copy ladder\prep\SaveGameList.sav over SaveGameList.sav, and ladder\c0\crossed-wands.sav -> HL-00-09.sav, ladder\c1\open-world-l34.sav -> HL-01-09.sav, ladder\c2\welcome-gryffindor-common-room.sav -> HL-02-09.sav, ladder\c3\prologue-ancient-path.sav -> HL-03-09.sav (all four HL files must exist before the game starts: an entry without its file may be dropped).
Steam Cloud stays on (the user accepted it): these files upload as the user's saves.
prep.verify: Start the game without UEVR: every card shows 2099. 1. 1. (the list was taken); clicking ARAM HAN loads the open world outside Rookwood Castle. If the cards show their old dates, or the game rebuilt the list, use the fallback (Hogwarts-loadgame with SaveGameList-2001.sav).
prep.undo: hl_save.py unregister on each HL-0c-09 entry (byte-exact inverse of register), or put the backed-up folder back; delete the four HL-0c-09.sav files after that.

notes: Story order = file order (every character's own rungs come before its community rungs, which the story order gives anyway). Tier 1 = 9 rungs from the prologue to the post-game: the six segments the user named (prologue, first day / classes, Crossed Wands, Hogsmeade, Rookwood's Trial, L34 open world) plus niamh-trial-v8 (the late story on the installed build), final-repository-pre-choice and room-of-requirement-vivariums (community); tier 2 adds the other story points and regions, tier 3 extra places and formats.
Each rung names its recipe: the save slot (HL-0c-09) and the card to click depend on the character, and run-ladder.ps1 cannot pass -SaveAs, so there is one recipe per character (same steps).

Own saves cover the story up to Rookwood's Trial (aram han L34). Community rungs (the ones with "source_archive") cover Potions Class / house quests, the Map Chamber reveal, Flying Class, Percival Rackham's Trial, the late story (The Polyjuice Plot, Lodgok's Loyalty, San Bakar's Trial, the quest before The Final Repository), The Final Repository before the ending decision, both ending variants post-game, the Room of Requirement with four vivariums and a 100% post-game travel base. Still missing: Arrival / the Sorting Ceremony (no downloaded save is there) and a played-out ending choice (pending ending-choice-a/b).
Save versions: aram han's rungs from 2024/2025 are version 6 (build 1235957); the rest are version 8 (1420267 / 1613387). The installed game is 1613387.
run-ladder.ps1 reads only "rungs"; "pending_rungs", "alternates" and "community_downloads" are for the next discovery session.

Community rungs: a save goes into the HL-0c-09 slot of its own CharacterID (hl_save.py ladder-file refuses another character's slot), so the recipe follows the save: character 0 -> Hogwarts-save-c0 (card A H), 2 -> Hogwarts-save-c2 (HARRY PORTER), 3 -> Hogwarts-save-c3 (GEN Z). No community rung uses character 1, so open-world-l34 stays the last ARAM HAN rung. Ladder files are patched like the own ones (DirectoryEntry: FilenameSlot HL-0c-09, USER, 2099-01-01; 9-14 bytes; the database untouched); the rung's "source" is the byte copy of the community file, "source_archive" / "source_path_in_archive" where it came from.

Unverified, the first community rung is the probe: whether the game loads, under one of the user's character cards, a save of another character (another name / house / UID inside). Loading one and the autosave a minute later are expected to rewrite that character's SaveGameList entry (the card's name, house, level) and its autosaves HL-0c-10..14 with the community character: back the folder up first (prep step 1) and put it back after the ladder. Because the card name can change, every community rung passes card_cp=char_select (the route waits for the character screen instead of the card's name, then clicks card_xy as before).

After the ladder the cards A H / HARRY PORTER / GEN Z load the last community save of their slot (HL-00-09 post-game-travel-base, HL-02-09 map-chamber-reveal, HL-03-09 post-game-ending-b) until the prep files (or the backup) are put back.

Community save versions: 2 and 3 (2023 builds 1117238 / 1121649 / 1126182; their database is plain SQLite, which is how the catalog reads quest state, Floo Flames and the ending), 8/1613387 = the installed build (map-chamber-reveal, room-of-requirement-vivariums, post-game-travel-base; Oodle-compressed database, read from the metadata only). The game upgrades old saves on load, but a 2023 save on build 1613387 is untested here: if one fails to load, use the same point in another format (alternates).

Speedrun practice saves (PracticeSaves_ca22ee18.7z) were made on the 2023-03 build; their file names are the run's segment names. Their Important Note.txt: duplicated ancient-magic meter bars reset to 5 after a menu exit (harmless for a load test). Ten of them have no DirectoryEntry (only usable raw, not as ladder files; see alternates no-directory-entry).

Ending variants: the save records the decision as FGS_01_Decision (made after the final goblin fight, before the Ranrok fight) and the completion journal FGS_BeneathHogwarts_MissionCompleteA / B (stat M_FGS_01_FigChoice 1 / 2). Which in-game option is A and which is B is not in the save data; post-game-ending-a and post-game-ending-b are one finished save of each.

Mirror rungs (2026-10-02, from runs\community-saves\Hogwarts\mirror): niamh-trial-v8 (stackmator HL-00-07, installed build 8/1613387, Winter: Niamh Fitzgerald's Trial before Lodgok's Loyalty), post-ending-before-house-cup (TheSpiderCrab HL-00-05, version 6: the first save after the ending, before The House Cup) and post-game-south-swamp-v8 (stackmator HL-00-00, installed build); pending floo-sweep-all-flames-c0 (legilimens-2, version 2, 86/86 Floo, character 0). All character 0 (card A H, Hogwarts-save-c0, card_cp=char_select), installed like the other community rungs. The two stackmator files are a public repo's test fixtures with CharacterName / CharacterUID replaced by X's: an untested variant of the 'another character in the card's slot' probe; restore the folder after the ladder as for every community rung. post-game-travel-base stays the last character-0 rung, so the A H card still ends on it.
